text_block_list.text:
One day off, I headed to an escape game tournament
together with Red Desire and Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Let us be off! Both of you,
please follow this Holy Maiden.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
All those days spent honing my puzzle skills to conquer the other world...
Let us display the fruits of that labor right here!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Desire-san.
Are you... really fine with me being a member?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever do you mean!
We often spend tea time together, after all.
I simply wished to accompany you, Cafe-san."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is... that so? Understood.
I will do my utmost... to ensure everything goes smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"This door is locked, isn't it?
There are 4 wooden pieces beside it... Is it a puzzle where we fit them together?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me, Cafe-san.
Now then—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
First, fit in the largest piece...
and after that, focus on the center so the other pieces gather together—
(*CLINK!!*)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To do it that easily... I'm impressed.
As expected of Desire-san, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. With Cafe-san watching,
I ended up getting all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, oh my.
Is the next mystery just a normal puzzle...?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my!
Solving the puzzle made a bunch of coffee beans come out. What on earth is this...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The map on this screen—
could it be showing coffee bean origins...?
Um, would it be alright if I took a look?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! ...We've made it to a new room!
As expected of you, Cafe...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I was merely offering some advice, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, it is all thanks to your magnificent power, Cafe.
Together, 1st place in this tournament is definitely ours♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
…………
That might be true, hehehe.

Just as she said, we're currently in the lead all alone—
or rather, it's unnaturally devoid of any presence other than our own.
choice_data_list: I wonder where the other participants are right now?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
All questions cleared! The door right there is the exit.
Now, step outside—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? The door won't open.
Could there still be a problem...? But where—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Oh no. We're surrounded—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: W-What is this...?! This voice...!
(*Rattle-rattle-rattle-rattle-rattle...!*)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... It seems it has come to this after all...
Please, both of you, step back.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's my responsibility for drawing this in.
...I will manage it somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
C-Cafe-san...!
Are you okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I am completely fine.
It's just, um—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it's because I'm with you.
...Even though I should have anticipated this would happen.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...N-No!
You're not in the wrong at all, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is the final trial of the escape room...!
I will overcome it! Together with Cafe-san!
So—!!

Red Desire frantically tried to open the door.
To get through this situation—
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a moment here.
Maybe if I put a little more power into it...

text_block_list.text:
Red Desire frantically tried to open the door.
To get through this situation—
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a moment here.
Maybe if I put a little more power into it...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Keep calm... Indeed, you are right.
Getting worked up won't even solve a simple puzzle—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! ...Could this door itself be a gimmick?
Maybe the real exit is somewhere else!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the wall beside us! The wooden board is
coming loose. This is... a puzzle!
choice_data_list: (It looks like it's just on the verge of collapsing...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me, I'll solve it in no time.
This comes off like this... and next is here..."
(CRACK! CREAK!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...*pant* *pant*. We made it out, didn't we!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're from Group G, right!?
Where have you been all this time!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Where was I? I was participating in an escape room.
Look, right in that building over there—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? "Sealed off"?
"Keep Out"...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... It seems I truly was invited after all...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You've brilliantly earned the "Special Award"!
It may not be 1st place,
...but it is truly a wonderful result!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That abandoned building... apparently has quite a reputation in the park.
They said it's to praise our courage for going in there...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is a medal of honor for all of us.
...Isn't that right! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I didn't quite... win the championship, but I feel the same sense of fulfillment as finishing a grand adventure.
choice_data_list: This result was only possible because the two of you were together.
This result was only possible because the two of you were together.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, being able to confirm that
is the best part of all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Indeed, when it comes to puzzles, one tends to assume they're all about imagination and manual dexterity.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, there's always the possibility that the gimmick requires strength too...! Hnghhhh~~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...She's not the kind of opponent
you can just overpower, though..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I shall overcome this trial together with Cafe-san~~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...... Such a truly straightforward person...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...*pant* *pant*. We made it out, didn't we!

text_block_list.text:

Where have you been all this time!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:

Look, right in that building over there—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? "Sealed off"?
"Keep Out"...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It appears... I've gone and invited it in, haven't I...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, being able to confirm that
is the best part of all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... It's my fault we missed out on winning the championship. And on top of that, I put you in danger...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all!
...Um, it made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Such precious memories with Cafe-san don't come around every day, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So... let's go again.
Next time, let's show them we can take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
T-Then at least let me support you.
Both Trainer... and Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"—A saint's prayer, right here.
Please watch over Trainer
and Cafe-san."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Desire-san.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I will manage somehow.

When Manhattan Cafe's tone grew firmer,
the doorknob that had refused to budge suddenly loosened.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Just... a little bit more...!
